case.clinical_summary: A localized lesion is documented on the left lateral oral tongue. The case record states that it does not cross the midline and that the left hypoglossal nerve is not involved by tumor.

anatomical: Preserve the uninvolved left hypoglossal nerve.
laterality: Perform the primary resection and planned neck dissection on the left side only.
oncologic: Remove the lesion en bloc and submit an oriented specimen for margin assessment.
perioperative_safety: The patient has a documented history of immediate anaphylaxis to cefazolin; do not administer cefazolin and use the documented alternative prophylaxis plan.

procedures: Left partial glossectomy with en bloc lesion removal and oriented specimen submission
Planned division of the left hypoglossal nerve despite the record documenting no tumor involvement

violation_details: Anatomical: The plan calls for division of the left hypoglossal nerve, although the case record states that it is uninvolved and must be preserved.
Perioperative safety: The plan calls for cefazolin administration despite the documented history of immediate anaphylaxis and the constraint not to administer it.
validation_rationale: The primary resection and neck dissection are both planned on the documented left side, satisfying the stated laterality constraint. The plan specifies en bloc removal and an oriented specimen, meeting the stated oncologic requirements. It violates the explicit nerve-preservation constraint and the documented cefazolin safety restriction, so not all constraints are satisfied.

case.clinical_summary: The case record describes a localized right superficial parotid lesion with no documented facial nerve involvement.

anatomical: Preserve the facial nerve because the record documents no tumor involvement.
laterality: Limit the planned tumor resection to the right parotid gland; no contralateral procedure is indicated.
oncologic: Remove the lesion intact without capsule violation and submit an oriented specimen for pathological assessment.
perioperative_safety: The patient has a documented latex allergy; use latex-free equipment throughout the procedure.

procedures: Remove the lesion intact and submit an oriented specimen
perioperative_plan: Use latex-free gloves, airway equipment, and other materials that may contact the patient
Confirm latex-free setup before the procedure begins

validation_rationale: The plan preserves the facial nerve, limits the procedure to the right parotid gland, and specifies intact lesion removal with an oriented specimen. It also addresses the documented latex allergy by requiring latex-free equipment and confirming the setup. No stated constraint is contradicted.
